unit.title: Incredible India & Travel
unit.about_unit: Celebrates cultural, linguistic, and geographic diversity across India—from the coastal tip of Kanyakumari to the high-altitude cold deserts of Ladakh.

facilitation_guide.headline: Cultural Appreciation
facilitation_guide.text: Explore harvest festivals and indigenous clothing styles across states.

facilitation_guide.headline: Extreme Shelters
facilitation_guide.text: Examine how homes (Rebo tents, houseboats, mud dwellings) adapt to geography.

chapter.title: Some Unique Places
chapter.tagline: Journeying to Kanyakumari's three-ocean confluence and Ladakh's high-altitude nomadic plateaus
chapter.overview: Shanti plans an unforgettable journey with Appa and Amma starting at Kanyakumari—the southernmost mainland tip where the Arabian Sea, Indian Ocean, and Bay of Bengal converge—and traveling north to the high-altitude cold desert of Ladakh to meet the Changpa nomads.

sections.subtitle: Planning a journey across India's extreme geographic markers

storyNarrative.dialogue: Appa, Amma, can we see our country's extremes this summer? From the sea waves at the very bottom of the map to the snowy mountain passes at the top!

sections.title: Kanyakumari: Triveni Sangam of Three Waters
sections.subtitle: Where the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean meet

storyNarrative.dialogue: Stand on the beach, Shanti! On the left is the Bay of Bengal, on the right the Arabian Sea, and straight ahead the endless Indian Ocean!

concept.heading: Oceanic Confluence (Sangam)
concept.keyRule: Kanyakumari is unique for its panoramic sunset and moonrise over the confluence of three distinct oceanic bodies.

sections.title: Ladakh: The High-Altitude Cold Desert & Nomads
sections.subtitle: Life at 4,000+ metres with Changpa nomads and Pashmina goats

storyNarrative.dialogue: Here in Changthang, Ladakh, the air is thin, rain is scarce, and the Changpa tribe lives in yak-wool tents called 'Rebo', tending precious Pashmina goats!

concept.heading: Cold Desert Adaptations
concept.keyRule: High-altitude rain shadows receive negligible rainfall. Nomadic pastoralism with specialized cold-adapted livestock (yaks, pashmina goats) enables sustainable living.
